Referenzen

🕌 · Kühlung für Spritzguss · AGD-15IA · × 3

Problem
12 injection machines frequently stopped in summer due to high oil temperature.
Lösung
3 units of AC-15 air-cooled chillers with independent oil circuits.
Ergebnis
Stoppages down 90%, defect rate cut by 30%.

🇲🇽 · Kühlung für Blasformen · AGD-15IW · × 3

Problem
10 blow molding machines running in the same workshop: in summer the hydraulic oil exceeded 65 °C, parison temperature drifted and bottle wall thickness went out of tolerance, with frequent overheat shutdowns.
Lösung
2 units of AGD-15IW water-cooled chillers, with separate temperature control loops for hydraulic oil and molds, supplying chilled water at a constant setpoint to keep oil temperature and parison temperature stable.
Ergebnis
Oil temperature held below 50 °C, wall thickness back within tolerance, zero summer shutdowns due to heat, and a sharp drop in scrap rate.

🇮🇩 · Kühlung für Extrusion · AGD-30IW · × 2

Problem
Fluctuations in cooling water temperature, dimensional deviations, and material scorching during PVC profile shaping
Lösung
AGD-30IW
Ergebnis
The product issues have been completely resolved, and the boss is very satisfied.
